findings.body: The third success question asks for Actual for each MIS statement line, and the expected result is a combined statement whose lines equal the two per-plant statements. This note admits that the returned answer contained only 22 lines and omitted the other 59 because the model added an unrequested `actual_net > 0` filter. That is not the requested complete combined statement, so the recorded run is not 5 of 5 and cannot close Done-when 10. Correct the selection behavior and rerun the live check.
findings.title: Not done: all five live success questions answer as expected
